I asked the waiter in Vietnamese (my mother tongue) at least 5 times if there was any meat in a specific dish (to make sure I even asked for pork, beef, chicken specifically). Told him I was strictly pescatarian due to health reasons, and he still served me a pork dish where the pork was not immediately recognisable. Further, my partner’s dish was also wrong. Absolutely horrendous service, and food was bad too once they corrected it, and of course we still had to pay for it. I absolutely advise against coming here, especially if you have any dietary restrictions.

Drop into Cat Ba but do not leave! Stay and enjoy the Flamingo 🦩
Feb 2026 • Solo
I recently stayed onsite at the beautiful resort here on Cat Ba! The staff in all areas are kind courteous and attentive! I joined the restaurant two nights in a row and have been so impressed both evenings! Each evening I tried the seafood dishes! First the steams prawns with Lemongrass - not to be missed! The second evening I tried the grilled tiger prawns with chilli jam - wow! Later I was tempted by the fresh seafood spring rolls - also very delicious! On the first night I had room for desert! I had the lava cake! So tasty and not sickly sweet as most cakes of this kind are - but this has so much taste but so less sugar! I have been very satisfied and have already told many friends about this beautiful destination as a must see and stay lo-cal!
